sources.query: SELECT TRADING_PARTNER_NAME, TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID, TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT, BUDGET_IMPACT_IND, D_C_INDICATOR, AMOUNT, JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, RECORD_CATEGORY, GL_PERIOD, BALANCE_TYPE, TRADING_PARTNER_ID, PERIOD_NAME, EXCEPTION_CATEGORY, DOLLAR_AMOUNT, REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE, DACT_REPORT_IND, PIID, PARENT_AWARD_ID, FAIN, URI, DOC_NUM, DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE, AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM, ETL_PROC_WID, INTEGRATION_ID, CREATED_ON_DT, DELETE_FLG, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, W_INSERT_DT, W_UPDATE_DT, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME, EVENT_ID, TP_OPDIV, TP_LEDGER_WID, GL_ACCOUNT_WID, MCAL_PERIOD_WID, LEDGER_WID, GL_JE_SOURCE_WID, GL_JE_CATEGORY_WID, POSTED_DATE, FUND_VALUE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE, FED_NON_FED, TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_F

SELECT fs.TRADING_PARTNER_NAME, fs.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID, fs.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT, fs.BUDGET_IMPACT_IND, fs.D_C_INDICATOR, fs.AMOUNT, fs.JE_HEADER_ID, fs.JE_LINE_NUM, fs.RECORD_CATEGORY, fs.GL_PERIOD, fs.BALANCE_TYPE, fs.TRADING_PARTNER_ID, fs.PERIOD_NAME, fs.EXCEPTION_CATEGORY, fs.DOLLAR_AMOUNT, fs.REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE, fs.DACT_REPORT_IND, fs.PIID, fs.PARENT_AWARD_ID, fs.FAIN, fs.URI, fs.DOC_NUM, fs.DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE, fs.AE_HEADER_ID, fs.AE_LINE_NUM, fs.INTEGRATION_ID, fs.CREATED_ON_DT, 'N' AS DELETE_FLG, fs.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, fs.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, fs.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME, fs.EVENT_ID, (SELECT MIN(a.ROW_WID) FROM W_GL_ACCOUNT_D a WHERE a.INTEGRATION_ID = fs.CCID AND a.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = fs.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND a.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y') AS GL_ACCOUNT_WID, (SELECT MIN(p.ROW_WID) FROM W_MCAL_PERIOD_D p WHERE p.MCAL_YEAR = fs.PERIOD_YEAR AND p.MCAL_PERIOD = fs.PERIOD_NUM AND p.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = fs.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID) AS MCAL_PERIOD_WID, (SELECT MIN(l.ROW_WID) FROM W_LEDGER_D l WHERE l.INTEGRATION_ID = fs.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID AND l.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = fs.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID) AS LEDGER_WID, (SELECT MIN(js.ROW_WID) FROM W_GL_JE_SOURCES_D js WHERE js.INTEGRATION_ID = fs.JE_SOURCE) AS GL_JE_SOURCE_WID, (SELECT MIN(jc.ROW_WID) FROM W_GL_JE_CATEGORIES_D jc WHERE jc.INTEGRATION_ID = fs.JE_CATEGORY) AS GL_JE_CATEGORY_WID, fs.POSTED_DATE, fs.FUND_VALUE, fs.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, fs.AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE, fs.FED_NON_FED, fs.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS fs
sources._expandedQueryDraft_BLOCKED_missingTable: WITH base AS (SELECT fs.*, (SELECT MIN(m.OPDIV) FROM W_GTAS_IGT_OPDIV_LKP m WHERE m.AID='075' AND m.TP_MAIN_ACCOUNT=fs.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT AND NVL(m.AID_EXCLUSION,'X')<>'075') AS PASS2, (SELECT MIN(m.OPDIV) FROM W_GTAS_IGT_OPDIV_LKP m WHERE m.AID='ALL' AND m.TP_MAIN_ACCOUNT=fs.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT AND NVL(m.AID_EXCLUSION,'X')<>'075') AS PASS1, (SELECT MIN(z.OPDIV) FROM (SELECT main_account, OPDIV FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D WHERE main_account IN (SELECT main_account FROM (SELECT A.main_account, B.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, COUNT(*) c FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D A, W_CFRS_ORG_XWALK_D B WHERE NVL(SUBSTR(A.OPDIV,1,INSTR(A.OPDIV,'-')-1),A.OPDIV)=B.OPDIV_NAME AND (A.FR_ENTITY='7500' OR A.FR_ENTITY IS NULL) GROUP BY A.main_account, B.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME) GROUP BY main_account HAVING COUNT(*)=1)) z WHERE z.main_account=fs.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT) AS OPDIV_TP_RAW, (SELECT MIN(z.OPDIV) FROM (SELECT main_account, nvl(ATA,'X') ATA, NVL(sub_account,'X') SUB_ACCOUNT, opdiv AS OPDIV FROM (SELECT a.opdiv, a.main_account, A.ATA, A.sub_account, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.opdiv, a.main_account, A.ATA, A.sub_account ORDER BY B.EXPIRATION_DATE) rn FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D a, w_treasury_symbol_d b WHERE (a.main_account) IN (SELECT main_account FROM (SELECT main_account, COUNT(*) c FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D GROUP BY main_account HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AND a.TREASURY_SYMBOL = NVL(b.tas, b.treasury_symbol) AND a.opdiv = DECODE(b.ledger_wid, 2, 'CMS', b.PSC_OPDIV) AND NVL(b.CANCELLATION_DATE, SYSDATE+1) > SYSDATE AND (a.FR_ENTITY='7500' OR a.FR_ENTITY IS NULL)) WHERE rn=1) z WHERE z.main_account=fs.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT AND z.ATA='X' AND z.SUB_ACCOUNT='X') AS OPDIV_TP_CNT_RAW, (SELECT MIN(z.OPDIV) FROM (SELECT A.main_account MAIN_ACCOUNT, NVL(A.ATA,'X') ATA, NVL(A.sub_account,'X') SUB_ACCOUNT, A.opdiv OPDIV FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D A, (SELECT MAIN_ACCOUNT, ATA, SUB_ACCOUNT, COUNT(*) c FROM (SELECT a.main_account MAIN_ACCOUNT, NVL(A.ATA,'X') ATA, NVL(A.sub_account,'X') SUB_ACCOUNT, a.opdiv OPDIV FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D a WHERE (a.main_account) IN (SELECT main_account FROM (SELECT main_account, COUNT(*) c FROM W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D GROUP BY main_account HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AND (a.FR_ENTITY='7500' OR a.FR_ENTITY IS NULL) GROUP BY a.main_account, NVL(A.ATA,'X'), NVL(A.sub_account,'X'), a.opdiv) GROUP BY MAIN_ACCOUNT, ATA, SUB_ACCOUNT HAVING COUNT(*)=1) B WHERE A.MAIN_ACCOUNT=B.MAIN_ACCOUNT AND NVL(A.ATA,'X')=B.ATA AND NVL(A.SUB_ACCOUNT,'X')=B.SUB_ACCOUNT GROUP BY A.MAIN_ACCOUNT, A.ATA, A.SUB_ACCOUNT, A.OPDIV) z WHERE z.MAIN_ACCOUNT=fs.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT AND z.ATA='X' AND z.SUB_ACCOUNT='X') AS OPDIV_TP_CNT_LST_RAW FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS fs), calc AS (SELECT base.*, CASE WHEN base.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID='075' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(base.PASS2),''), NULLIF(TRIM(base.PASS1),''), NULLIF(TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(base.OPDIV_TP_RAW,'-')>0 THEN REPLACE(SUBSTR(base.OPDIV_TP_RAW,1,INSTR(base.OPDIV_TP_RAW,'-')-1),' ','') ELSE base.OPDIV_TP_RAW END),''), NULLIF(TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(base.OPDIV_TP_CNT_RAW,'-')>0 THEN REPLACE(SUBSTR(base.OPDIV_TP_CNT_RAW,1,INSTR(base.OPDIV_TP_CNT_RAW,'-')-1),' ','') ELSE base.OPDIV_TP_CNT_RAW END),''), NULLIF(TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(base.OPDIV_TP_CNT_LST_RAW,'-')>0 THEN REPLACE(SUBSTR(base.OPDIV_TP_CNT_LST_RAW,1,INSTR(base.OPDIV_TP_CNT_LST_RAW,'-')-1),' ','') ELSE base.OPDIV_TP_CNT_LST_RAW END),'')) END AS CALC_TP_OPDIV FROM base) SELECT calc.TRADING_PARTNER_NAME, calc.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID, calc.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT, calc.BUDGET_IMPACT_IND, calc.D_C_INDICATOR, calc.AMOUNT, calc.JE_HEADER_ID, calc.JE_LINE_NUM, calc.RECORD_CATEGORY, calc.GL_PERIOD, calc.BALANCE_TYPE, calc.TRADING_PARTNER_ID, calc.PERIOD_NAME, calc.EXCEPTION_CATEGORY, calc.DOLLAR_AMOUNT, calc.REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE, calc.DACT_REPORT_IND, calc.PIID, calc.PARENT_AWARD_ID, calc.FAIN, calc.URI, calc.DOC_NUM, calc.DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE, calc.AE_HEADER_ID, calc.AE_LINE_NUM, calc.INTEGRATION_ID, calc.CREATED_ON_DT, 'N' AS DELETE_FLG, calc.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, (SELECT ETL_PROC_WID FROM W_PARAM_G WHERE ROW_WID = 1) AS ETL_PROC_WID, calc.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, calc.PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME, calc.EVENT_ID, calc.CALC_TP_OPDIV AS TP_OPDIV, (CASE WHEN (SELECT MIN(w.ROW_WID) FROM (SELECT CFRS.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, CFRS.OPDIV_NAME, LGR.ROW_WID FROM W_CFRS_ORG_XWALK_D CFRS, W_LEDGER_D LGR WHERE CFRS.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME=LGR.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME AND LGR.ROW_WID<>3 AND LGR.DELETE_FLG='N' GROUP BY CFRS.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, CFRS.OPDIV_NAME, LGR.ROW_WID) w WHERE w.OPDIV_NAME = calc.CALC_TP_OPDIV) IS NULL THEN (SELECT MIN(w.ROW_WID) FROM (SELECT LGR.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, LGR.ROW_WID FROM W_LEDGER_D LGR WHERE LGR.DELETE_FLG='N' AND LGR.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND LGR.ROW_WID<>3 GROUP BY LGR.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, LGR.ROW_WID) w WHERE w.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME = calc.CALC_TP_OPDIV) ELSE (SELECT MIN(w.ROW_WID) FROM (SELECT CFRS.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, CFRS.OPDIV_NAME, LGR.ROW_WID FROM W_CFRS_ORG_XWALK_D CFRS, W_LEDGER_D LGR WHERE CFRS.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME=LGR.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME AND LGR.ROW_WID<>3 AND LGR.DELETE_FLG='N' GROUP BY CFRS.LEDGER_SHORT_NAME, CFRS.OPDIV_NAME, LGR.ROW_WID) w WHERE w.OPDIV_NAME = calc.CALC_TP_OPDIV) END) AS TP_LEDGER_WID, (SELECT MIN(a.ROW_WID) FROM W_GL_ACCOUNT_D a WHERE a.INTEGRATION_ID = calc.CCID AND a.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = calc.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND a.CURRENT_FLG = 'Y') AS GL_ACCOUNT_WID, (SELECT MIN(p.ROW_WID) FROM W_MCAL_PERIOD_D p WHERE p.MCAL_YEAR = calc.PERIOD_YEAR AND p.MCAL_PERIOD = calc.PERIOD_NUM AND p.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = calc.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID) AS MCAL_PERIOD_WID, (SELECT MIN(l.ROW_WID) FROM W_LEDGER_D l WHERE l.INTEGRATION_ID = calc.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID AND l.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = calc.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID) AS LEDGER_WID, (SELECT MIN(js.ROW_WID) FROM W_GL_JE_SOURCES_D js WHERE js.INTEGRATION_ID = calc.JE_SOURCE) AS GL_JE_SOURCE_WID, (SELECT MIN(jc.ROW_WID) FROM W_GL_JE_CATEGORIES_D jc WHERE jc.INTEGRATION_ID = calc.JE_CATEGORY) AS GL_JE_CATEGORY_WID, calc.POSTED_DATE, calc.FUND_VALUE, calc.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, calc.AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE, calc.FED_NON_FED, calc.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE FROM calc

_notes: MCAL_PERIOD_WID join corrected vs prior deleted draft: real SQ_W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS SQL override joins PERIOD_YEAR=MCAL_YEAR AND PERIOD_NUM=MCAL_PERIOD (no swap) -- prior draft had it backwards.
GL_ACCOUNT_WID subquery corrected to include a.CURRENT_FLG='Y', present in the real join but missing from the prior draft.

ATTEMPTED (per user request) to actually reproduce ETL_PROC_WID, TP_OPDIV, TP_LEDGER_WID in JDBC 2 rather than excluding them -- BLOCKED by a confirmed environment gap, not by complexity. The full expansion SQL is preserved as JDBC 2's '_expandedQueryDraft_BLOCKED_missingTables' field for reuse once the environment gap below is resolved. ETL_PROC_WID = (SELECT ETL_PROC_WID FROM W_PARAM_G WHERE ROW_WID=1), since $$ETL_PROC_WID has no XML DEFAULTVALUE and no dataops.config.yaml override so IIF($$ETL_PROC_WID=0,...) always takes the lookup branch. TP_OPDIV/TP_LEDGER_WID reproduce the full 5-level fallback cascade from mapplet HHS_mplt_SIL_GTAS_Get_TP_Ledger_WID (LKP_TP_MAIN_ACCT_OPDIV_MAPPING x2, LKP_MAIN_ACC_OPDIV, LKP_MAIN_ACC_OPDIV_CNT, LKP_MAIN_ACC_OPDIV_CNT_LST, then LKP_LEDGER_OPDIV/LKP_LEDGER_OPDIV_HHS) via a WITH base/calc CTE, pulling in 5 tables not previously read by this test case: W_PARAM_G, W_GTAS_IGT_OPDIV_LKP, W_GTAS_TREASURY_XWALK_D, W_CFRS_ORG_XWALK_D, w_treasury_symbol_d. CONFIRMED BLOCKER: deploying this query via update_data_flow failed output-schema resolution with ORA-00942 'table or view does not exist' against the live W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS JDBC connection (Oracle, schema 'sh') -- isolated by testing just the ETL_PROC_WID/W_PARAM_G addition alone, which failed identically, confirming W_PARAM_G itself is not registered/accessible in this environment (and, by extension, the other 4 new GTAS-specific tables are unlikely to be either -- this connection's schema owner 'sh' looks like Oracle's generic sample schema, not a populated HHS/GTAS instance). Reverted JDBC 2 to the previously-working query so the live dataflow is not left broken. Needs DBA/environment verification (confirm these 5 tables exist and are reachable via this data source) before the draft query can be redeployed. ASSUMPTIONS baked into the draft (unverified, since the mapplet's 'AID' input port has no traceable source expression in the compact summary and the source query has no ATA/SUB_ACCOUNT columns): AID is a hardcoded '075' (HHS's own agency code -- matches the v_TP_OPDIV IIF guard AID='075' AND AID_TRADING_PARTNER='075'), and ATA/SUB_ACCOUNT both default to 'X' (their NVL(...,'X') fallback, since no source column feeds them) -- re-verify these too once the tables are reachable.

W_INSERT_DT, W_UPDATE_DT remain excluded (ignoreColumn) deliberately, NOT due to complexity -- both map 1:1 to Informatica's SESSSTARTTIME (session-start clock time), which is not a function of source row data. Two independent JDBC queries in a DataCompare have no shared session-start concept to reconcile against; including them would either always fail (real historical load timestamp vs. a freshly computed one) or be a meaningless pass (both sides just call the current timestamp). Left excluded on purpose.

Composite key (JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM, BALANCE_TYPE, RECORD_CATEGORY, GL_ACCOUNT_WID, LEDGER_WID, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID) inferred from the fact's grain -- confirm against the real target table PK/unique constraint if possible before build.

FIX (post run330422 analysis): GL_ACCOUNT_WID and LEDGER_WID changed from uniqueKeyColumn=true to false. Run 330422's DataCompare showed 4 duplicate keys on each side under the original composite key; analysis-agent attributed this to GL_ACCOUNT_WID/LEDGER_WID being derived dimension-lookup columns (populated via correlated subqueries), not part of the real business key. Remaining unique key columns unchanged: JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, RECORD_CATEGORY, BALANCE_TYPE, AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID. The real target table PK/unique constraint is still UNCONFIRMED -- no tool was available this session to query Oracle constraint metadata directly; needs SME/DBA verification before this fix can be considered final.

Data source availability was previously confirmed blocked in this environment (ORA-00942 on W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_F, dimension tables not registered as data sources in DevContainer 518) -- re-verify current source/data-source registration state before build.
